memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks 30 min daily, manages household chores.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (recall 2 items, clock drawing normal).
falls: No falls in past 12 months. Gait steady, no sway. Timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular. Polypharmacy – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports occasional low mood, denies hopelessness or anhedonia.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goals: "I want to stay active and keep my independence for as long as possible."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.4 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2). eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73m² (>60 normal). Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 85 mg/g (<30 normal). Haemoglobin 12.4 g/dL (12‑16). Serum sodium 138 mmol/L (135‑145). H. pylori stool antigen negative.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent, reports mild knee discomfort after prolonged standing.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (annual due).
falls: No falls in past year. Gait antalgic left knee, mild limp. Timed up‑and‑go 11 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (added ibuprofen PRN for knee). Polypharmacy – review Beers.
mood: Mood stable, denies depression.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goals: "I wish to keep walking without pain and avoid hospital visits."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports occasional heartburn after spicy meals, otherwise ADLs intact.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 3/5 (recall 1, clock draw mild abnormality) – positive screen.
falls: No falls past year. Gait normal. Timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular. Polypharmacy – request Beers review.
mood: Mentions feeling ‘frustrated’ with reflux, denies depression.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goals: "I want to enjoy my meals without burning and stay out of the clinic."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.6 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2). eGFR 40 mL/min/1.73m². Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 110 mg/g. Haemoglobin 11.8 g/dL. Serum sodium 137 mmol/L.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Resting ECG: Normal sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No ST‑T changes. No evidence of ischemia or arrhythmia.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports increased fatigue, needs rest after grocery shopping.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not due (annual done Oct 2025).
falls: One fall at home 2 months ago while reaching for top shelf, no injury. Gait slightly unsteady. Timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds – raised fall risk.
medicines: 6 regular. Polypharmacy – Beers review indicated.
mood: Reports low mood, occasional tearfulness.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goals: "I want to feel stronger and avoid any more falls."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.8 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2). eGFR 35 mL/min/1.73m². Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 150 mg/g. Haemoglobin 11.0 g/dL. Serum sodium 134 mmol/L (borderline low).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Nephrology, Dr S. Rao, for progressive CKD (eGFR 35 mL/min/1.73m²) with rising creatinine and albuminuria. Request assessment for possible steroid‑sparing agents and dialysis planning education.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Nephrology reply: Patient reviewed, CKD stage 3b. Continue current RAS blockade and SGLT2i. Add spironolactone 12.5 mg OD for albuminuria, monitor potassium. Educate on low‑sodium diet. No immediate dialysis needed. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Messaged via clinic app: ‘I’ve been having a burning sensation after meals despite taking pantoprazole. Also feel more tired lately. Could my reflux be worsening?’

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed from 2026-07-15 10:00 to 2026-07-20 14:00 per patient request to accommodate daughter’s schedule.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports improved energy after anemia work‑up, walks 20 min with rest.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (recall 2, clock draw normal).
falls: No new falls since Jan. Gait steady. Timed up‑and‑go 11 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (added spironolactone 12.5 mg OD). Polypharmacy – Beers review completed, no potentially inappropriate meds.
mood: Mood improved, denies depression.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goals: "I want to keep my strength up and enjoy time with my grandchildren."
